generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Rates shall be quoted in tender in bill of quantities in the website itself.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work at his own cost.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the Joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy 26 PPT 2022 dtd.26.04.2022
Bidders shall undertake to comply with the entire requirement under EPF and MP Act 1952 and cover all the workmen to be engaged for the work entrusted by the corporation under the PF Act.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, labor welfare cess etc., and other statutory taxes, duties, levies, cess as applicable at the prevailing rates under GoK/GoI Acts and relevant notifications

In case of the death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
Defect liability/Maintenance period for the work is 12 (Twelve) months from the date of completion of the work.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
In the item description in Schedule-B, the material to be used for the work should confirm with relevant IS standards. The material can be procured/used only after approval from Engineer in charge

The location where the work is to be carried out is to be completely studied. Any electrical cables, power cables, transformers, OFC, etc., laid need to be understood. The safety of men, material and instruments is to be strictly taken care. Any lapse/ incidents/ accidents/loss is the total responsibility of bidder.
The contract may be foreclosed/extended beyond the original contract period as per the decision of KPCL

Electric Power/Water required for carrying out the work will be made available free of cost to the extent possible and bidder shall exercise utmost care for judicious use of the same. Any extension could be made by the contractor at his/her own cost.
The corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP portal.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the e-proc portal only

GST: (a) In KPPP Portal it is mentioned as Inclusive of all taxes whereas rates uploaded are exclusive of GST. Agency has to quote the rates exclusive of GST. GST will be added at prevailing rates at the time of Agreement. (b) As per Govt. order FD:447: Exependiture:12/2022 Bangalore dt. 30-7-2022 G.S.T will be paid at 18% or applicable rates at the time of payment of RA Bills, subject to verification.

In KPPP Portal it is mentioned as Inclusive of all taxes whereas rates uploaded/amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. Agency has to quote the rates exclusive of GST. GST will be added at prevailing rates at the time of Agreement.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Superintending Engineer RO (Civil), KPCL, Bengaluru-560001 during office hours (9.30 am to 5.00pm)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Replacement of Basement Sump Pumps, Providing Booster Pump for MD Chamber & Board Room Water Supply and Dewatering Pumps for waste water collection Pit at Shakthibhavan, Bengaluru

itemList.description: Providing 5 HP openwell Submersible Pump Set confirming to IS 8034-2000; 3Phase, 415 Volts 2880rpm as per specifications with 2" delivery , to work site as per necessary ammendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work etc., complete

Supply and delivery at site GM (copper alloy) gate valves confirming to Class-I as per IS 778 with latest amendments, 1 No. screwed in bonnet inside screw, rising spring spindle integral seat screwed females ends confirming to IS 554/ 1990 body hydraulically tested 1.5HP seat standard tested 1 HP with IS mark. For 50 mm dia GM (Copper alloy) Gate valves
Supply and delivery at site of brand new best make non-return valve as per IS 778/1984 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments Size 50 mm
Providing mini pressure booster Pump set of 0.5 HP to work at site as per necessary ammendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work.

Providing Dewatering Pump set of 2.00 HP Outlet Dia - 2.00" with auto float switch & with cutter suitable for Openwell and confirming to IS 8034-2000, SS Bowl & Impeller with Low volt Motor as per specifications, to work site as per necessary amendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work complete.,

Labour charges for Erection, Electrification and commissioning of Pump sets, including aligning and balancing of all items including supply and erection of two pair of supporting clamps, bore well caps, cable clips and water tight gland cable protectors, bolts, nuts, valve and gauges,tools and equipments etc., involved in the job as per specifications, with necessary tests as per specifications, with testing of as per instructions of engineer incharge of work.

Supply, installing,testing and commissioning COMMON control panel consisting of the following INCOMING:1 No set of Phase indicating lamps with SFU of suitable rating 1 No, Analog Ammeter, 1 No Analog Voltmeter 1ni with Phase selector switch, Isolating switch OUTGOING for Main Electrical Pump: 1 No. MCB 1 No. DOL of S/D Starter suitable for respective HP 1 No. Electrcal Protection Like single Phase preventor, under voltage over Volage, under current over current & dry run protection suitable for the pump described above 1 no Indoor type NOTE: 1) DOL- Direct Online Starter
2) S-D- Star Delta Starter etc. complete. 3 to 6 HP pumps

Supply and delivery at site 50mm(2”) dia heavy duty unplasticized PVC Column pipes with heavy duty collars,rubber profile ring,vibration control profile ring,freezing and turbulence free leak proof EPDM ring with ISI mark with its latest amendments

Labour charges for erection of indoor type panel board and meter board units with all necessary materials and labour tools and equipments including cement concrete for foundation/bed etc,complete as per specification, with testing of as per instructions of engineer incharge of work.

Flexible Hose pipe PVC 50 mm (2 Inch) Heavy Water Suction Hose Pipe 30 Meter (100 Feet Approx) Roll For conveying and discharging the water collected in the dewatering collection pit to the designated discharge point. Ultra Light & Flexible With PVC Spiral Ribbed For Extra Strength
Providing & installation of Water level Controller three phase to work site as per necessary amendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work complete.,

Supplying and drawing 3C x 2.5 mm2 Flexible Multicore Cable manufactured with electrolytic grade flexible copper with low conductor confirming to IS8130- 1984 and (Virgin) PVC insulation sheathed suitable for working voltage up to 1100 Volts as per IS-694:1990
